Brainstorm: Pipeline Jujur - honest write, honest rank, lean artifacts. Chose: repair one end-to-end chain - signal predicate + content hash in post_tool_use.py before observe then purge the 84%-noise corpus; swap embedder to multilingual paraphrase-multilingual-MiniLM-L12-v2 at 384 dim (cheap because the purge cuts 17.3k rows to ~2.7k); ORDER BY rank + real BM25 distance + source field in memory.py FTS path; invert injection default to zero-unless-it-clears-a-relative-floor; gate docs injection off until the index is real; plan fields Rollback/Breaking change/Anchor become exception-only enforced by existing ec-review Stage 1.5; split Verify into local evidence (per task, ms) vs global invariants (module boundary + review); honest Dependencies actually consumed by ec-execute for co-location fusion (41 tasks -> ~25 units) and ordering; range reads instead of 18120-token whole-plan reads; fix etok git status dead branch and git log --oneline data loss plus the shell wrapper leak that kept a measured 74% build-log saving permanently dormant; delete duplicate non-prefixed command family. Unifying invariant: silence beats a wrong answer. Because: Tier-1-only scores highest on composite (20 vs 16) but fails the pre-mortem - it makes scores honest without making retrieval useful, since the English-only embedder leaves all 4 benchmark queries at distance 1.19-1.25 against a 1.2 threshold, and it touches none of the 18.1k plan bloat or 93s compile cost. Rust-first is measured at 0% on accuracy, token cost and quality. Rejected parallel DAG spawning and the Rust rewrite as explicit non-goals - different problems (throughput, footprint) with their own risk, both far smaller after this pass. Key unmeasured assumption: a multilingual 384-dim model on the de-noised corpus clears a real relevance bar; the relative floor makes failure safe (zero injection) with bge-m3 as fallback.
